lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Please provide us your email, so we can sent you a login code. Then click the Send Code button.

lines.label: enter-the-code
lines.said: We will send you a four-digit code to that address. [[slnc 800]] If you are not seeing it, please check your spam folder.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: This is your admin dashboard. [[slnc 500]] Open a Business with the store you want to work on.

lines.label: find-the-business
lines.said: Start typing your business name, [[slnc 300]] then select it from the dropdown list.

lines.label: the-business
lines.said: When your business page opens. [[slnc 500]] Choose Lookup Stores to see all the stores of this business.

lines.label: find-the-store
lines.said: Start typing the name of the store you are looking for, [[slnc 300]] and select it from the dropdown list. [[slnc 500]] All activities after this will act against this store alone.

lines.label: the-store
lines.said: This is the store page. [[slnc 500]] Click on the gear icon in the menu and choose Lookup Collections.

lines.label: collection-list
lines.said: Here you can find all the store's look up and search options. [[slnc 500]] Press the plus icon button to add a new collection.

lines.label: new-collection
lines.said: Give the collection a unique name. [[slnc 500]] A collection is a group of items that can differ just by their options, or could be some like or similar items.

lines.label: collection-details
lines.said: Add a description to guide your renters. [[slnc 4000]] Then set the starting price, in cents only, meaning no decimal point.

lines.label: collection-options
lines.said: Options are what makes one item different from another. [[slnc 800]] The label is what renter will see. [[slnc 500]] The name is the system key the item is saved under, and used for an item match. [[slnc 800]] The type can bool, string or a number. [[slnc 500]] The required option means this item is needed to complete the order and should always be true. [[slnc 500]] The values are the list of selections the dropdown will offer.

lines.label: the-collection
lines.said: After the collection is saved. [[slnc 500]] We can create an item from every one of these variants.

lines.label: back-to-the-store
lines.said: Scroll up and use the back arrow to return to the collections page. [[slnc 1000]] Then we can return to the store page. [[slnc 2000]] Open the menu again using the gear icon. [[slnc 1000]] Then choose Lookup Items.

lines.label: item-list
lines.said: This is where all the store's items can be found. [[slnc 500]] To add a new item, click the plus icon button.

lines.label: new-item
lines.said: Give the item a name with the variants added. The renter can see by the item name that they are getting the item options they want. [[slnc 500]] Then search and select the collection this item belongs to. [[slnc 1500]] Use the Create button to save it.

lines.label: item-details
lines.said: Build out the item here, in the details page. [[slnc 2000]] Add an Item description, [[slnc 2000]] Confirm you are in the right collection. [[slnc 2000]] Then add how many of this specific item you have for rent. [[slnc 2000]] Then add the price in cents. [[slnc 2000]] The requirement is the set of questions, [[slnc 500]] that a renter answers for the equipment items they are renting from you. [[slnc 2000]] The attributes may hold some image details that will be automatically added. [[slnc 500]] So you can skip over this.

lines.label: item-detail-variants
lines.said: Finally add the specific options for this item. [[slnc 500]] Select the brand variant from the dropdown list. [[slnc 2000]] Then select the length variant. [[slnc 2000]] The star after the option name indicates that you made these a required field. [[slnc 500]] This means the renter will need to make a variant selection. [[slnc 2000]] Then click the update button to save it.

lines.label: first-variant
lines.said: That is the first variant saved. [[slnc 1000]] Use the duplicate button to make a copy of this item.

lines.label: the-other-variants
lines.said: Update the new item with the same name, but with the different variant options. [[slnc 1000]] Always remember to update this new item before you use the duplicate again. [[slnc 500]] Work through all the 9 possible variations.

lines.label: last-variant
lines.said: All nine variants now exist in the collection. [[slnc 1000]] 3 different brands. [[slnc 500]] Each with 3 different lengths.

lines.label: sign-out
lines.said: Back at the dashboard when you are done. [[slnc 300]] Logout is a card here, same as the rest.

lines.label: signed-out
lines.said: You are signed out. [[slnc 500]] Your collection and all nine of its variants are saved and ready to rent.
